run_gmock_doctor_cli: run gmock_doctor.py to diagnose Google Mock compiler errors pasted on stdin
diagnose_compiler_errors: call Diagnose with a compiler error message string to get plain English diagnoses
create_custom_diagnoser: create a new diagnoser function using _GenericDiagnoser with regex patterns and diagnosis templates
review_NRR_diagnoser: review the _NeedToReturnReferenceDiagnoser function that detects Return vs ReturnRef misuse
review_NRS_diagnoser: review the _NeedToReturnSomethingDiagnoser function that detects void action used where a return value is needed
